description: Main source file for a Flutter-based personal notes application, containing the app's widget tree, note model, local database handling via SQLite, state management, and various screens for viewing, editing, and searching notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note with id, title, content, and update timestamp.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing local SQLite database operations such as opening the database, querying, inserting, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier to handle notes list, search, and CRUD operations, providing data to the UI.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying a list of notes with options to add, view details, search, or delete notes.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Custom SearchDelegate for live search filtering of notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one.

classes.name: NoteDetailsScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying detailed view of a note with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application. Initializes and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each widget class, defining UI structure.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from local database, filtered by optional search query.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database by id.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Saves a note (new or edited) via provider, then navigates back.

methods.name: _openEditor
methods.description: Navigates to note editor screen, optionally with an existing note.

methods.name: _openDetails
methods.description: Navigates to detailed view of a note.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation.
